formula: r1Target (inventory business − R1-extra noise) − (deep_pass page OR handwritten family purpose entry) = remaining gap

meta.r1ExtraNoise: NetworkMessages.*; Messages.From*/To*/BattleServer*/CustomBattleServer*/Lobby* (+ remaining Messages.*); top-level BattleServer*/CustomBattleServer*/Lobby*; psai.*; type IMB*/BattleServer*/CustomBattleServer*/Lobby*
meta.note: COVERED if an R1-target inventory identity has a deep_pass page declaring the same qualified (version, language, namespace, typeName) identity OR a qualified handwritten family entry. Unqualified family entries count only when the simple name is unique in inventory. Formulaic purposes do not count. S-tier requires standalone deep pages. R1-extra noise stays inventory-listable but is out of the denominator.
